scope: L5 bounded startup/artifact/payload-install evidence; separate from Radiomics, Machine Learning & Statistics and Pathology performance scores.

preparation.fresh_environment: Create one new venv with system-site-packages=false from the existing CPython3.9.21 base; environment creation is untimed setup, recorded separately.
preparation.installation: Exactly one offline pip install --no-index --no-deps --no-cache-dir of the fixed wheel into the fresh empty environment. No resolver/download/dependency installation; record one elapsed value and logs, not a median or full-install claim.
preparation.dependency_scope: Project wheel payload only. NumPy/Pandas/Matplotlib and optional reference/container packages are not installed by this operation. Import/backend_info may work through lazy imports; full analysis functionality still requires declared base dependencies.
preparation.external_mutation: Do not modify the public3.0.1 environment, existing benchmark environments, root source, version, wheel, CLI or machine-wide configuration.

startup_cases.expected: Exit0; stdout identifies radiomics0.1.0; no Python program or feature/model algorithm is started.

argv: import json,ov_radiomics as rad;from ov_radiomics import _native;print(json.dumps({'version':rad.__version__,'backend':rad.backend_info(),'implementation':_native.IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256},sort_keys=True))
startup_cases.expected: Exit0; actual backend rust, version0.1.0 and fixed implementation constant; installed package file bytes match fixed wheel in non-timed preflight.

measurement.order: Round0 CLI then Python; round1 Python then CLI; alternate through seven fixed rounds. This order reduces drift but is not a cross-endpoint speed comparison.
measurement.timer: Coordinator perf_counter immediately before process creation to wait/communicate completion, including process startup, import/command, stdout/stderr transport and exit. Source/package/input byte audits, decoding and footprint scans are outside elapsed time.
measurement.cold_definition: Fresh process/interpreter for every observation. OS file/bytecode cache is not flushed and remains explicitly uncontrolled; no cold-disk claim.
measurement.raw: Retain all14 per-endpoint observations, round/order, argv, stdout/stderr bytes/decoded results, exit code, elapsed, environment/build/source digests and failures. Do not select minimum or drop a slow/failed sample.
measurement.host_window: Start only after main/acceptance confirm no overlapping benchmark, dependency installation or build; record host/power/storage limitations and UTC start/end.

footprint.artifacts: Exact wheel compressed file bytes, ZIP entry/file count/uncompressed payload bytes, and standalone CLI file bytes; hashes must match immutable receipt.
footprint.installed_payload: Project package and its dist-info regular-file count and summed logical bytes; baseline and post-install complete fresh-venv counts/bytes also recorded. Reject symlink traversal; no recursive deletion.
footprint.metric_limits: Logical file-byte totals are not filesystem allocation/cluster occupancy, base Python/shared system DLL footprint or complete dependency footprint. Those remain explicitly unmeasured.

acceptance: Validate source/artifact/installed byte identity and outputs. Startup failure or output mismatch is an operational result retained in raw evidence. No shared target, language-wide speedup, combined suite score or full dependency-install cost is inferred.
approval: Main agent must approve exact JSON SHA before payload install or startup timing. No post-result case/repetition/source changes.
